description: This file defines a Java interface 'ModifyCommandAdapterProvider' that provides methods to obtain adapters for modify commands and their responses within the Eclipse Ditto protocol adapter framework.

classes.name: ModifyCommandAdapterProvider
classes.description: A generic interface in the Eclipse Ditto protocol adapter framework that provides adapters for modify commands and responses.

methods.name: getModifyCommandAdapter
methods.description: Returns an adapter for the modify command of type M.

methods.name: getModifyCommandResponseAdapter
methods.description: Returns an adapter for the modify command response of type R.
